format: dashboard

```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(42)

# Generate random data for visualizations
months <- c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")
sales_data <- data.frame(
  month = factor(months, levels = months),
  sales = c(3200, 3500, 4100, 3800, 4500, 5200, 4900, 5100, 5400, 5800, 6100, 6500),
  profit = c(800, 950, 1100, 900, 1200, 1450, 1300, 1350, 1500, 1600, 1700, 1850)
)

# Generate scatter plot data
scatter_data <- data.frame(
  x = rnorm(100, mean = 50, sd = 15),
  y = rnorm(100, mean = 50, sd = 15),
  category = sample(c("A", "B", "C"), 100, replace = TRUE)
)

# Generate time series data
days <- 1:30
revenue_data <- data.frame(
  day = days,
  revenue = 5000 + cumsum(rnorm(30, mean = 100, sd = 300))
)
```

## Row {height=40%}

### Column

```{r}
#| title: "Monthly Sales Performance"
ggplot(sales_data, aes(x = month, y = sales)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#667eea", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = profit * 4, group = 1), color = "#ff6b6b", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = profit * 4), color = "#ff6b6b", size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Sales ($)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~./4, name = "Profit ($)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Month")
```

### Column

```{r}
#| title: "Revenue Trend (Last 30 Days)"
ggplot(revenue_data, aes(x = day, y = revenue)) +
  geom_line(color = "#764ba2", size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "#667eea", fill = "#667eea", alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Revenue ($)")
```

## Row {height=40%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Category Distribution Analysis"
ggplot(scatter_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = category)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("A" = "#667eea", "B" = "#764ba2", "C" = "#ff6b6b")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Metric X", y = "Metric Y", color = "Category")
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Top Performing Months"
top_months <- sales_data %>%
  arrange(desc(sales)) %>%
  head(6)

knitr::kable(
  top_months,
  col.names = c("Month", "Sales ($)", "Profit ($)"),
  format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
)
```
